title: ToolDescriptor
description: Declared tool ABI for a RemoteAdapter-exposed tool: capability identity, opaque argument/result subschemas, and metadata. Declared in HostCapabilityManifest.tools.

capability_id.description: Tool capability string `tools.<ns>.<tool_id>`. The namespace MUST be owned by the declaring manifest (namespaces[] membership); tool_id is an open-ended vocabulary.

op.description: Wire op for this tool. MUST equal capability_id (spec-level rule; draft-07 cannot express cross-field equality, so helpers enforce it).

input.description: Opaque JSON Schema draft-07 subschema describing tool arguments. An empty object `{}` declares no constraint (unconstrained ABI).

output.description: Opaque JSON Schema draft-07 subschema describing the success result. An empty object `{}` declares no constraint (unconstrained ABI).

idempotent.description: Advisory idempotency metadata only; the protocol defines no idempotency-key machinery.

examples.description: Look up a knowledge entry by id.
Rank candidate entries against a query.
